_documentation.enabled: Set to false to disable the extension entirely.
_documentation.command: Slash command name (without /). Changes take effect after /reload.
_documentation.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut for cycling the active agent. Set to null to disable. Must be a key format understood by pi (e.g. 'alt+a', 'ctrl+a', 'f2'). Ctrl+Shift+letter combos require Kitty keyboard protocol or xterm modifyOtherKeys and do NOT work on Windows Terminal.

footer.enabled: Show coloured agent status in the footer.
footer.statusKey: Status bar key used by ctx.ui.setStatus().
footer.prefix: Text shown before the agent id.
footer.colors: Map exact agent ids to #RRGGBB colours. Unlisted agents get a deterministic colour hashed from the id.
footer.noneColor: Colour used when no main agent is selected.
